What's changed

Main regime: ff.preprocess=false, ff.fused_reduction=trueAll other mathematical and search parameters are the same; seed 0. V ff_polynomial.cpp:820–839 reduction updates F := F + scalar·monomial·G It's a direct way to build an intermediate product and then add it up, preserves the assumptions used and the exact arithmetic of the field, and the number of internal steps may differ: the result of the comparison relates to the implementation with the previous numerical budget, not to the identical sequence of all events.

No restrictions have been removed: 135 states, 134 square-link z=s², 134 transitional a,b,c, a≠0, Exact boundaries of entire representatives and former gauge. Full-length formula: 17497 variables, 17659 statements. Initial 83 masks and omissions saved, all 3767 Observable bits; hidden bits and witnesses are not passed on to the search process SMT coinciding with the old SEQ-24. Only the parameters of the algorithm have been changed.

Technical corrections are not hidden: two early launch attempts have ended before check off-road WSL and the definition of a downloaded library A3 The repeated values of the diagnostic statistics were mistakenly read as the first value; these detailed indicators are not used for selection. Worker v3 They keep all the records and add them together A4 Check the equality of the number of copies and native checks. STATISTICS_CORRECTION.md An additional deeper profile has not been collected: WSL restarted and cleared the temporary assembly tree; failure occurred before the source codes were changed, the archives were saved and the control system was ready/The instrumental libraries are not affected.

For further accurate search, it makes sense to keep the optimizations found. The main open question now is getting stronger limits on branches without guessing the full set of bits; this experiment did not develop such a method.
